title: Simplified Adventure
description: Bored of the vanilla experience? Then here is a twist of Mods which will enhance your survival experience!
body:
Are you bored of the Vanilla experience? Well then you came to the right place! This Modpack has specially been crafted to add new features to minecraft while keeping the vanilla feel. We have modified it so that you can run it smoothly!

---------------------------------------
**Features:**

- New weapons & armour (Medieval armour/weapons, warden armour, spears etc)

- New and Better structures

- Bosses

- Magic (Wands, hats, Waystones)

- JourneyMap

- VoiceChat
  

And much more!

----------------------------------------

**Note:**
If you wish to use this modpack with your friend, you can host your world with Essential (it is included in this modpack)
